description: User 360 search page where you can look up users by insured ID and view their profiles. Also serves as the detail view when an insuredId parameter is present.

elements.label: User 360 Search Input
elements.description: Text input for entering an insured ID to look up a user profile.

elements.label: Search User Button
elements.description: Button that triggers the user search by insured ID.
exampleUserQuestions: where to click to search user

elements.label: Refresh User 360
elements.description: Button that refreshes the user 360 detail data.

elements.label: Churn Probability KPI
elements.description: Shows the churn probability and risk level for the user.

elements.label: Average Risk Last 30 Days
elements.description: Shows the average risk score over the last 30 days.

elements.label: Alert Count Last 30 Days
elements.description: Shows the total number of alerts for this user in the last 30 days.

elements.label: Critical Alert Count Last 30 Days
elements.description: Shows the number of critical alerts for this user in the last 30 days.

elements.label: User Persona
elements.description: Card showing the user persona classification and source.

elements.label: User Baseline
elements.description: Card showing user baseline data including usual country, active hours, and top API families.

elements.label: Next Event Prediction
elements.description: Card showing predicted next event actions for this user with probabilities and rankings.
exampleUserQuestions: highlight next event prediction on user 360
what will this user do next

elements.label: Recent Sessions
elements.description: Card showing the user's recent sessions with risk scores and session IDs.

elements.label: Risk Timeline
elements.description: Card showing the user's risk score timeline over time with timestamps and risk levels.

elements.label: User Alerts Table
elements.description: Table showing alerts for this user with risk level, score, timestamp, anomaly type, event action, and investigation actions.

elements.label: Live Connection Badge
elements.description: Badge showing the SSE live connection status for user 360.

elements.label: Data Source Chip
elements.description: Chip showing the data source for the user 360 data.
exampleUserQuestions: what is the user data source
